item.title: South Africa reels from spate of mass shootings killing 38 in one week
item.description: A spate of mass shootings in three major South African cities has left at least 38 people dead in a single week, shocking a country already known for one of the world’s highest murder rates. On Saturday night, 17 people were killed when eight suspects armed with AK-47 assault rifles and pistols…

item.title: Russian strikes across Ukraine kill at least seven, hit National Academy of Sciences in Kyiv
item.description: Russian forces launched a wave of drone and missile strikes across Ukraine on Monday, killing at least seven people and wounding more than 50 others, officials said. item.title: White House cancels $810M in health and education funds, sparking clash with Congress
item.description: Under Article I of the Constitution, Congress holds the 'power of the purse' — it decides how federal money is spent once appropriated into law.
